quotes.summary_phrase: Rick Carlisle on Pacers' rebounding and shooting struggles
quotes.excerpt: didn't play well enough and didn't get enough rebounds to get anything going
quotes.quote: Didn't play well enough and didn't get enough rebounds to get anything going. We had some pretty good looks that didn't go down, but it wasn't simply a case of make or miss. We've got to retrieve the ball when it comes off the board.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle says the Pacers struggled to get anything going tonight because they failed to retrieve the ball off the glass. He noted that while they missed some good looks, it was not just a case of make or miss.

structured.context: Rick Carlisle discusses the team's poor rebounding and shooting performance following a loss.
